NOTICE
NO.HCM.II1/166/2019-JudI ./Part-1/599 Dated Shillong, the 21st September, 2026
It is hereby notified for the information of all concerned that today, the 21st September,
2026, the Division Bench comprising Hon’ble Mr. Justice H.S. Thangkhiew and Hon’ble Mr.
Justice W. Diengdoh, and the Single Bench of Hon’ble Mr. Justice H.S. Thangkhiew will not
sit
Accordingly, all matters listed before the aforesaid Benches shall stand adjourned and will
be listed in due course
By OrsJer,
